Chapter 6948: Kneel

Chapter 6948: Kneel

In theory, a golden immortal couldn’t muster the true strength of a legacy artifact. Only fifty or sixty percent was impressive.

However, Treasure was Breaker’s son, giving him an innate affinity with the weapon. Direct disciples didn’t have this advantage.

He had also played with it as a child, not to mention his current empowered state by the heavenly pulse.

“Boom!” The swing traveled through Treasure Immortal Realm. This firmament was the same size as the nine worlds and thirteen continents.

Nevertheless, the swing still delivered death to the whole firmament. Everything turned to ashes. Oceans dried up in the blink of an eye.

Mortals watched their world change dramatically before meeting their end. Keep in mind that since it was his home, he had blessed it before with many fortifications. Alas, it was still shattered and returned to death instantly.

When the hammer reached Li Qiye, the stone head’s existing cracks widened, unleashing a death domain against Li Qiye.

The hammer exerted its dominion over him with an immemorial power. It gave the impression of an invisible hand from the high heaven of death pushing down, never allowing him to rise again.

Death, with the help of time, intended to grind him down.

“Unfortunately, you’re no high heaven.” Li Qiye smiled.

He grabbed the invisible hand and dragged it out.

“Ahh!” Treasure’s arm was torn apart.

With nothing grasping it, the hammer flew away and the domain disappeared to Breaker’s astonishment.

Li Qiye emerged again before the attackers.

“That’s it?” He stared at the seven immortals who tried to flee but it was too late.

“Boom!” His gaze crushed the heavenly pulse.

They utilized their strongest treasures and techniques, displaying a high level of destruction affecting the river of time.

“Rumble!” His supreme will crushed their techniques and treasures before immobilizing them.

They fell to another firmament; their knees crashed against the ground and were pulverized.

“Ahh!” They didn’t understand how their indestructible body became so fragile like a mortal.

Spectators looked down at their knees and were horrified.

The seven tried to resist since kneeling in public was more humiliating and unbearable than death. They roared to gather more strength, wanting to resist the invisible force.
